info.title: Stupid Zombies NX
info.author: Terremotixx
info.description: Nintendo Switch port of Stupid Zombies 3
info.details: Stupid Zombies NX is a Nintendo Switch wrapper/port of Stupid Zombies 3.4.5 for Android ARM64. Aim and fire using the controller, with optional gyroscope aiming and cursor controls. A legally obtained copy of Stupid Zombies 3.4.5 for Android is required. Original game files are not included and must be provided by the user.

changelog:
Initial release.  
- Controller-based cursor and aiming
- Optional gyroscope aiming
- Touch-style input mapped to Switch controls
- Pause/resume and cursor visibility controls
- Stable gameplay and level transitions
